newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse daily volume hits peak in May.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse daily volume hits peak in May.

text.p: Average daily volume on the Paris bourse totalled 9.54 billion francs last month, an increase over the previous high of 9.22 billion in February 1997, the French stockmarkets association SBF said on Tuesday.
It said the bourse's capitalisation totalled 3,348 billion francs on May 30.
The key indices fell. The CAC-40 dropped 2.1 percent, the SBF120 fell 2.7 percent, the SBF250 fell 2.6 percent, the MIDCAC fell 4.6 percent and the second market index lost 4.1 percent.
The Nouveau Marche small cap market registered 16,792 trades in May, a daily average of 884, down 2.1 percent from April, the SBF said in a statement.
